1. This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 27.04.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge, Rohini, New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 156/2019 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No. 12/2005-06 pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala, Delhi.
